root_cause_analysis.root_cause: During security hardening (Phase 4), 5 backend routers were given require_admin router-level dependency. Couriers have role=courier, not admin, so they got 401 Forbidden.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Changed router-level dependency from require_admin to require_auth in 5 files
root_cause_analysis.verification: All 5 endpoints now return 200 with courier token, 401 without token
